description: A systemized catalog of middle-school mathematics topics (grades 7–9). Each topic is modeled as a standalone interactive HTML lesson: includes detailed explanation, prerequisite knowledge, learning objectives, suggested visuals (images, graphs, animations, simulations), interactive activities, quick assessments, and metadata for page generation.
notes: Every topic entry is intended to map to a single HTML page component. The 'interactive_elements' field lists recommended visual/interactive assets to include (images, SVGs, canvas animations, charts, parameter sliders, draggable constructions, three.js snippets where appropriate). Use the fields to auto-generate content via eduNest pipeline.
